acceptance_criterion: A clarification message is mandatory and must contain at least one non-whitespace character; an empty message is refused, no message is stored, and the event status is unchanged
test_name: refuses an empty message, storing nothing and leaving the status unchanged

acceptance_criterion: On sending, the event status changes to Awaiting Clarification and the requesting coordinator and timestamp are recorded
test_name: moves the event to Awaiting Clarification, recording who asked and when

acceptance_criterion: The message is stored against the event and is visible to the owning organiser and to Event Coordinators
test_name: lets the owning organiser see the outstanding clarification

acceptance_criterion: The message is not visible to users with no relationship to the event
test_name: gives an organiser who does not own the event no clarification content

acceptance_criterion: The organiser receives a notification identifying the event and the fact that clarification is required
test_name: notifies the organiser that clarification is required

acceptance_criterion: Multiple clarification messages on the same event are retained in order rather than overwriting each other
test_name: retains multiple clarifications in order rather than overwriting

acceptance_criterion: Only an Event Coordinator may request clarification (A2)
test_name: refuses a role that is not an Event Coordinator (A2)

acceptance_criterion: Status may only change through a permitted transition (F1)
test_name: refuses a clarification on an event that is not under review (F1)

acceptance_criterion: The organiser can see any outstanding clarification message on their own event
test_name: lets the owning organiser see the outstanding clarification

acceptance_criterion: The organiser can reply with a message, amend the request fields, or both
test_name: accepts an amendment with no message

acceptance_criterion: A response with neither a message nor an amendment is refused and no timestamp is recorded
test_name: refuses a response with neither a message nor an amendment, recording no timestamp

acceptance_criterion: On response the event status returns to Under Review and the response timestamp is recorded
test_name: returns the event to Under Review and records the response time

acceptance_criterion: The values as originally submitted are retained in the event history alongside the amended values
test_name: retains the value as originally submitted alongside the amended value

acceptance_criterion: The coordinator who requested the clarification is notified that the organiser has responded
test_name: notifies the coordinator who asked for the clarification

acceptance_criterion: An organiser who does not own the event cannot view or answer the clarification
test_name: gives an organiser who does not own the event no clarification content

acceptance_criterion: Approve is available only when the event status is Under Review or Awaiting Clarification
test_name: refuses to approve an event that has not been opened for review

acceptance_criterion: Approve is available when the event status is Under Review
test_name: approves an event that is Under Review, recording the coordinator and the time

acceptance_criterion: Approve is available when the event status is Awaiting Clarification
test_name: approves an event that is Awaiting Clarification

acceptance_criterion: On approval the status changes to Approved and the approving coordinator and approval timestamp are recorded
test_name: approves an event that is Under Review, recording the coordinator and the time

acceptance_criterion: The approval outcome and its date are visible to the owning organiser
test_name: shows the approval outcome and its date to the owning organiser

acceptance_criterion: The organiser receives a notification of the approval
test_name: notifies the organiser of the approval

acceptance_criterion: Approval alone creates no venue booking and no equipment reservation
test_name: creates no venue booking and no equipment reservation

acceptance_criterion: An event that already carries a recorded decision cannot be approved again and no second approval timestamp is written
test_name: cannot approve an event that already carries a decision, writing no second timestamp

acceptance_criterion: A rejected event cannot subsequently be approved
test_name: cannot approve an event that was already rejected

acceptance_criterion: The approval writes a status history entry like any other transition (F1)
test_name: writes a history entry for the approval (F1)

acceptance_criterion: Only an Event Coordinator may approve (A2)
test_name: refuses a role that is not an Event Coordinator (A2)

acceptance_criterion: A double decision is refused at the repository level, writing no second decision timestamp
test_name: writes no second decision timestamp for an event already decided

acceptance_criterion: Rejection requires a reason of at least one non-whitespace character; without it the rejection is not performed, the status is unchanged, and no rejection timestamp is recorded
test_name: refuses a rejection with no reason, changing nothing

acceptance_criterion: A reason of whitespace only is refused
test_name: refuses a reason of whitespace only

acceptance_criterion: On rejection the status changes to Rejected and the reason, rejecting coordinator, and timestamp are recorded
test_name: rejects an event with a reason, recording the coordinator and the time

acceptance_criterion: The reason is visible to the owning organiser
test_name: shows the reason to the owning organiser

acceptance_criterion: The organiser receives a notification of the rejection
test_name: notifies the organiser of the rejection, including the reason

acceptance_criterion: A rejected event cannot be edited or resubmitted; its fields become read-only
test_name: makes a rejected event read-only: it cannot be resubmitted

acceptance_criterion: An event that already carries a decision cannot be rejected
test_name: cannot reject an event that already carries a decision

acceptance_criterion: The rejection writes a status history entry like any other transition (F1)
test_name: writes a history entry for the rejection (F1)

acceptance_criterion: Only an Event Coordinator may reject (A2)
test_name: refuses a role that is not an Event Coordinator (A2)

acceptance_criterion: The rejection reason is recorded with the decision
test_name: records a rejection with its reason

acceptance_criterion: The organiser can amend the request fields, including its venue requirements, with the originals retained in the history
test_name: lets the organiser amend the venue requirements, keeping the original in the history

acceptance_criterion: Without a reason the rejection is not performed, and the refusal is shown where the reason is entered
test_name: shows the refusal inside the rejection dialog
